nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Triggered by Workflow B after a batch finishes matching. POST /webhook/notify with {batch_id}.

parameters.query: SELECT u.user_id, u.name, u.email, count(*) AS product_count, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('product_name', lp.product_name, 'lender_name', lp.lender_name, 'interest_rate_min', lp.interest_rate_min, 'interest_rate_max', lp.interest_rate_max, 'min_loan_amount', lp.min_loan_amount, 'max_loan_amount', lp.max_loan_amount, 'source_url', lp.source_url, 'score', m.score) ORDER BY m.score DESC NULLS LAST) AS products FROM matches m JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id JOIN loan_products lp ON lp.product_id = m.product_id WHERE m.batch_id = $1::uuid AND m.notified = FALSE AND m.is_active GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name, u.email ORDER BY u.user_id;

nodes.name: Fetch Matches Per User
nodes.notes: Attach 'Postgres - LoanDB' credential. One row per user with their matched products aggregated as JSON, newest/highest-score first. Only unnotified, active matches for this batch.

nodes.name: Has Recipients?
nodes.notes: If Fetch returned no rows there is nothing to send -> Respond 200 (empty).

nodes.name: Send via SES
nodes.notes: Attach an 'AWS' credential (access key with ses:SendEmail). The sender/recipient must be verified while the SES account is in sandbox. On error, continues so one bad address doesn't block the batch; failed sends are NOT marked notified below only if you gate on success — see note.

parameters.query: =UPDATE matches SET notified = TRUE, updated_at = now() WHERE batch_id = '{{ $('Validate Input').first().json.body.batch_id }}'::uuid AND user_id = '{{ $('Build Emails').item.json.user_id }}' AND notified = FALSE AND is_active RETURNING match_id;

nodes.name: Mark Notified
nodes.notes: Attach 'Postgres - LoanDB' credential. Flips notified=true per user so re-runs never double-email. Keyed on (batch_id, user_id).

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'ok', batch_id: $('Validate Input').first().json.body.batch_id, emails_sent: $('Build Emails').all().length }) }}
